heroSummary: Loudoun County Public Schools began the 2025–26 school year on Thursday, August 21, 2025. Following a March 2026 School Board revision, the final student day was Friday, June 12, 2026. Winter Break ran December 22 through January 2, and Spring Break ran March 30 through April 3.

calendarFaqs.q: When did LCPS start school in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Students began classes on Thursday, August 21, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: What was the final day of school for LCPS in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The final student day was Friday, June 12, 2026. The School Board moved it from June 15 as part of a March 2026 calendar revision.

calendarFaqs.q: When was LCPS Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026. Students returned Monday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When was LCPS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran Monday, March 30 through Friday, April 3, 2026. Students returned Monday, April 6.
